functionalReqs: Reserve stock at checkout; commit on payment; release on timeout or failure
Pick the warehouse to fulfil from
Audit log of every stock change
hints: Split stock into available, reserved and committed. What operations move units between them?
Locking per SKU-warehouse pair avoids a global lock. What about orders with many SKUs?

Inventory(sku, warehouse) with available/reserved counts updated via CAS or per-key locks (lock SKUs in sorted order to avoid deadlock); Reservation with expiry swept by a scheduler; WarehouseSelectionStrategy (nearest, most stock); StockObserver for low-stock alerts; immutable StockMovement audit records.
problemStatement:
Design an **inventory management** module for an e-commerce warehouse network: stock per product per warehouse, reservations during checkout, and replenishment.

During a flash sale, thousands of checkouts hit the same product at once; stock must never go negative.
title: Design Inventory Management with Concurrency
